tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅: thugs rje chen po yid bzhin nor bu 'gro ba kun sgrol gyi smon lam bde ba can ma bzhugs so:

'od dpag med kyi zhing bkod nas gsungs pa: bcom ldan shākya'i rgyal po'i zhing 'di nas: nub phyogs gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed: rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams bde ba can: khrag khrig phrag brgya 'das pa'i pha rol na: zhing khams skyon med rnam dag bde ba can: sa gzhi thams cad rin chen rang bzhin te: lag mthil ltar mnyam gcong rong med pa'i gnas: me tog padma'i tshogs kyis rab brgyan cing: blta bas mi ngoms mdzes shing yid du 'ong: zhing mchog de na lha mi'i ston pa ni: sku tshe dpag med rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bzhugs: nyon mongs sbyangs shing smon lam dag pa'i gnas: bdag dang 'gro kun zhing der skye 'gyur shog: dag gsal bkra ba'i zhing khams bde ba can: rgyal ba'i rnam 'phrul snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs 'byin: 'tsho ba'i yo byad ji ltar bsam pa bzhin: 'bad rtsol med par legs par 'byung ba'i gnas: zhing mchog de na sems can ngan song dang: lha ma yin dang gshin rje'i ming yang med: de na phal pa'i bud med yod ma yin: mngal na gnas pa'ang yod pa ma yin no: rin chen rnams kyi me tog padma las: brdzus te skye ba'i rang bzhin sha stag go: mi dge spangs shing smon lam dag pa'i gnas: bdag dang 'gro kun zhing der skye 'gyur shog: rnam dag 'od gsal zhing khams bde ba can: zhing der skyes pa'i sems can thams cad la: na tsha la sogs sdug bsngal gtan mi 'byung: zhing der skyes nas ngan song 'byung mi srid: mi khom gnas su skye ba'ang mi srid do: zhing der skyes pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams: tshe lo dpag tu med par sku bzhugs nas: skye ba du mar byang sems sar gnas te: spyod pa rlabs chen mdzad bzhed ma gtogs par: skye ba gcig rjes rdzogs 'tshang rgyas 'gyur zhing: tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs smon lam dag pa'i zhing: bdag dang 'gro kun zhing der skye 'gyur shog: thub pas bsngags pa'i zhing khams bde ba can:

dwangs ba can gyi rin chen pho brang na: sku tshe dpag med rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bzhugs: tshe dpag med mgon g.yas na spyan ras gzigs: byams dang snying rjes 'gro ba kun la gzigs: mgon po'i g.yon na byang sems mthu chen thob: dri med bstan pa rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzad: rgyal ba'i 'khor gzhan yon tan phun tshogs shing: ye shes cher rgyas bsam gyis mi khyab bzhugs: bdag ni nam zhig 'chi ba'i dus byung tshe: gnas ngan rnams su nam yang mi gol bar: lha mchog khyed kyi zhal mthong sngun bsus nas: bde ba can gyi zhing der skye bar shog: padma las 'khrungs dam chos nyan 'gyur zhing: rgyal bas lung bstan mngon shes rdzu 'phrul thob: sems can thams cad zhing mchog dam pa der: bdag gis 'dren pa'i rten 'brel sgrig par shog: de ltar bdag gis smon lam bzang po 'di: bla ma mchog dang mgon po spyan ras gzigs: 'khor bcas la sogs rgyal dang rgyal ba yi: sras mchog rnams kyis 'grub par mdzad du gsol: :
